Package org.apache.juneau.console.views

Record Class RowJobSubmit

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.apache.juneau.console.views.RowJobSubmit
Record Components:
action - The submitted action id.
targetId - The submitted row id.
idempotencyKey - The submitted key value.
fields - The submitted fields; empty when the body omitted them.
public record RowJobSubmit(String action, String targetId, String idempotencyKey, JsonMap fields) extends Record
The action-envelope submit of a row job: {action, targetId, idempotencyKey, fields}, the shape the row-action dialog and the job-log card's envelope: "action" both send.

parse(JsonMap) checks the shape; verify(JobKeyLedger, String, String) checks the action, then the key's recorded binding. The row identity is targetId() plus that binding — never anything in fields(), which is user-tamperable request data. An endpoint that also carries the row id in its path should check targetId().equals(pathId) first.

Example:

var submit = RowJobSubmit.parse(json); if (! submit.targetId().equals(id)) return refuse(res, RowJobSubmit.bindingRefusal()); var grant = submit.verify(jobKeys, "restock-species", actor); if (grant.isEmpty()) return refuse(res, RowJobSubmit.bindingRefusal()); // answered 409
